subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should this PR's automatic non-personal text/html Graph fallback be accepted after the normalization fix, or should maintainers require an opt-in or combined fallback design instead?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired mechanically, but the default fallback policy affects existing Teams deployments through extra Graph reads, permission expectations, diagnostics, and attachment-message context.

options.title: Accept Automatic Fallback After Repair
options.body: Normalize the content-type check, then merge this channel fix with the understood tradeoff that non-personal HTML stubs may trigger Graph media lookup.

options.title: Require Opt-In Fallback
options.body: Ask for a config-gated shape like the group-chat candidate if maintainers want existing installs to keep the current mention-only protection by default.

options.title: Combine Channel And Group Strategy
options.body: Pause this branch and ask for one reconciled PR that covers channel aadGroupId/reply URLs plus the group-chat HTML-stub fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Automatic Fallback After Repair
recommendation.body: Normalize the content-type check, then merge this channel fix with the understood tradeoff that non-personal HTML stubs may trigger Graph media lookup.
